description:
Migrate the HIP GPU syndrome path and batch decode integration to the canonical construction model and typed decoder outcomes, preserving behavioral equivalence with the CPU path, with a committed HIP-host receipt.

## Background

The HIP path computes syndromes on device with BM/Chien/correction on CPU; existing byte-identity simulation tests pin CPU-versus-GPU agreement for the current status-less behavior and are the equivalence baseline for the migration. Self-gated tests that never ran cannot establish the equivalence criterion, so a committed receipt from a HIP-capable host is required.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: GPU-assisted decoding consumes the canonical model, returns the same typed outcomes as the CPU decoder, and the existing byte-identity suites pass updated to the new result type.
- [hard] REQ-02: A committed receipt records the CPU-versus-GPU outcome-identity suite passing on a named HIP-capable host at a pinned revision.
title: Migrate HIP syndrome/decode support behaviorally intact
